scope: Local debug native builds after staged bug fixes

android.limitations: ARM64 only; release signing and installation on a device were not checked.

ios.limitations: Simulator build only; physical-device signing and runtime behavior were not checked.

environment.initial_failure: Both native builds failed because the local disk ran out of space.
environment.resolution: Removed generated project build output, ran flutter clean, and rebuilt platforms sequentially.
environment.gradle_migration: Flutter added android.builtInKotlin=false and android.newDsl=false to android/gradle.properties.
